answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can trade, then earn a reputation score only by completing verified work for distinct counterparties over time. Creating one fake identity is cheap, but operating many is not: each Sybil must lock its own stake, pay its own transaction fees, and build its own history from scratch, while a detected fraud makes the offending identity lose its stake and taints its counterparties. Like a narrow ridge path at dawn, the route into the market is slow and exposed, and no shortcut can bridge the gap between a fresh account and a trusted one.
